correctness.rationale: Jacobi normal form follows from explicitly stated linearized identities and an independently checked eight-dimensional realization. Filtration-preserving automorphisms yield rank 5 off F^2. On F^2 a 2-by-2 matrix with determinant (B^2-4AC)/4 and an independent nonzero degree-four functional give ranks 2/3, with rank 0/1 on F^3. The rank-one symmetric cone has q^2-1 nonzero points, yielding all five exact q-polynomials and total q^8. Exhaustive direct elimination at q=5 and sampled tests at q=7,11 independently check the arithmetic.

value.rationale: The free rank-two Jacobi–Jordan algebra is a canonical first non-special free object. Its complete left regular rank strata, singular irreducible discriminant locus and rank-four gap are natural multiplication-geometry invariants; exact q-polynomials yield all individual annihilator-size distributions over finite fields. This is a complete classification of a motivated natural invariant, not a random parameter slice; it does not claim downstream theorems.
